import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD2 = 1000000007L;
    static long n;
    static List<Integer>[] buckets = new ArrayList[10];
    static long[] sumArr = new long[10];
    static long count1 = 0, count2 = 0, answer = 0;
    static int[] powArr = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};
    static BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
    static StringTokenizer st;

    static long readNumber() throws IOException {
        long num = 0;
        int sign = 1;
        int ch;
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1) break;
            if (ch == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                break;
            }
            if (Character.isDigit(ch)) {
                num = ch - '0';
                break;
            }
        }
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1 || !Character.isDigit(ch)) break;
            num = (num << 1) + (num << 3) + (ch - '0');
        }
        return num * sign;
    }

    static boolean validRange(long x) {
        return x * 1000000 + 999999 <= n && x * 10000000 > n;
    }

    static void generate(int length, long val) {
        if (length > 6) return;
        buckets[length].add((int)((count1 - val + MOD1) % MOD1));
        sumArr[length] += (count1 - val + MOD1) % MOD1;
        ++count1;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
            generate(length + 1, val * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static void search(int length, long val) {
        if (val > n) return;
        if (validRange(val)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
                long v1 = ((count2 + 1 - val * powArr[i]) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
                int idx = lowerBound(buckets[i], (int)(MOD1 - v1));
                answer = (answer + (sumArr[i] + (long)buckets[i].size() * v1 - 1L * MOD1 * (buckets[i].size() - idx))) % MOD2;
            }
            count2 += count1;
        } else {
            if (length > 0) ++count2;
            answer = (answer + ((count2 - val) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1) % MOD2;
            int startDigit = (length == 0) ? 1 : 0;
            for (int digit = startDigit; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
                search(length + 1, val * 10 + digit);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        n = readNumber();
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            buckets[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        generate(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(buckets[i]);
        }
        search(0, 0);
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
